_about: Story steps per location, in play order. Written from game knowledge; item, Pokemon and gift lists come from the game's decompiled data.
pallet-town: Go downstairs and try to leave town; Professor Oak stops you and takes you to his lab.
Pick your starter: Bulbasaur (easiest early game), Charmander (hardest early game) or Squirtle. Your rival takes the one strong against yours.
Win or lose, your first rival battle is right after. Then head north on Route 1.
After delivering Oak's Parcel you get the Pokédex and 5 Poké Balls. Visit Daisy in your rival's house for the Town Map.
route-1: Grab the free Potion from the Poké Mart employee. Catch Pidgey and Rattata on the way to Viridian City.
viridian-city: The Poké Mart clerk hands you Oak's Parcel. Take it back to Professor Oak in Pallet Town.
After the delivery, the old man shows you how to catch Pokémon and gives you the Teachy TV.
The Gym is locked until you have seven badges. Head west to Route 22 for an optional rival battle, then north to Route 2.
Gym 8, Giovanni (Ground): Water, Grass or Ice. Opens once you have seven badges. Reward: Earth Badge and TM26 Earthquake.
route-22: Optional early rival battle near the gate. The Pokémon League gate at the west end is blocked until you have all eight badges.
route-2: Go north into Viridian Forest. The east side of the route needs Cut, so come back later.
With Cut: the house has an Abra-for-Mr. Mime trade, and Oak's aide gives HM05 Flash once you've registered 10 Pokémon.
viridian-forest: Bug Catchers everywhere. Pikachu is rare here (5%), so catch one now if you want it early. Exit north to Pewter City.
pewter-city: Gym 1, Brock (Rock): use Water or Grass moves. Bulbasaur and Squirtle walk it; Charmander should learn Metal Claw at Lv 13, or catch Mankey on Route 22.
Brock gives the Boulder Badge and TM39 Rock Tomb.
Come back with Cut for the Old Amber in the museum's back room.
route-3: Long trainer gauntlet. Catch Jigglypuff, Spearow and the version Nidoran. The Mt. Moon Pokémon Center has a Magikarp seller (buy it, it's worth it for Gyarados).
route-4: Magikarp salesman in the Pokémon Center: 500 Poké Dollars. Rest before entering Mt. Moon.
mt-moon: Zubat, Geodude, Paras and the rare Clefairy. Lots of items, including a Moon Stone on 1F.
Beat Team Rocket and the Super Nerd on B2F, then choose the Dome Fossil (Kabuto) or the Helix Fossil (Omanyte). The other one is gone for good.
Exit to the second half of Route 4 and continue east to Cerulean City.
cerulean-city: Rival battle on the bridge north of town; afterwards he gives you the Fame Checker.
Gym 2, Misty (Water): Grass or Electric. Her Starmie is fast and hits hard. Reward: Cascade Badge and TM03 Water Pulse.
Chase the Team Rocket grunt who robbed the house to get TM28 Dig.
Trade a Poliwhirl for a Jynx in the house. The Bike Shop gives you a Bicycle for the Bike Voucher.
route-24: Nugget Bridge: beat five trainers and then the Rocket at the end for a Nugget.
route-25: Visit Bill in the Sea Cottage, help him with the Cell Separator and get the S.S. Ticket. Then go south through Cerulean to Route 5.
route-5: The Day Care is here (it raises one Pokémon at a time). Use the Underground Path to reach Route 6 and Vermilion.
underground-path-north-south: Trade with the man in the north entrance for a Nidoran of the other gender.
route-6: Short route down to Vermilion City.
vermilion-city: Board the S.S. Anne with the S.S. Ticket.
The Fishing Guru gives you the Old Rod. The Fan Club Chairman gives you the Bike Voucher if you listen to his story.
Gym 3, Lt. Surge (Electric): Ground types are immune. Diglett from Diglett's Cave is perfect. You need Cut to reach the Gym, and the trash-can switch puzzle is inside.
Reward: Thunder Badge and TM34 Shock Wave.
ss-anne: Explore the cabins for items, beat your rival near the Captain's room, then rub the Captain's back to get HM01 Cut. The ship leaves once you get off.
route-11: Oak's aide upstairs in the gate gives the Itemfinder once you've caught 30 Pokémon. Diglett's Cave is at the west end.
digletts-cave: Diglett and Dugtrio. Ground types make Lt. Surge easy. The cave leads to Route 2, so you can now reach the east side with Cut.
route-9: Head east from Cerulean (cut the tree). Lots of trainers on the way to Rock Tunnel.
route-10: Pokémon Center by Rock Tunnel. Oak's aide here gives the Everstone once you've caught 20 Pokémon. The Power Plant is down the river (you need Surf).
rock-tunnel: Pitch dark without Flash (HM05 from the aide on Route 2). Exit south to Lavender Town.
lavender-town: Pokémon Tower is full of ghosts you can't identify yet. You need the Silph Scope from Celadon's Rocket Hideout.
After rescuing Mr. Fuji at the top of the tower he gives you the Poké Flute, which wakes the Snorlax.
route-8: Go west to Saffron's gate. The guards are thirsty, so buy a drink on Celadon's Department Store roof, then take the Underground Path to Celadon.
underground-path-east-west: Connects Route 8 and Route 7, skipping Saffron.
celadon-city: Department Store: buy evolution stones and TMs. On the roof, give drinks to the girl for TM16, TM20 and TM33.
Get a free Eevee from the Poké Ball in the Condominiums' roof room (back entrance). The old woman on the first floor gives you Tea, which gets you past the Saffron guards.
Gym 4, Erika (Grass): Fire, Flying, Ice or Poison. You need Cut to reach it. Reward: Rainbow Badge and TM19 Giga Drain.
The poster in the Game Corner hides the Rocket Hideout switch. The Coin Case is from the man in the restaurant.
rocket-hideout: A spin-tile maze. A grunt drops the Lift Key on B4F. Beat Giovanni for the Silph Scope, then go back to Pokémon Tower.
pokemon-tower: With the Silph Scope you can see the ghosts (Gastly, Haunter, Cubone). The Marowak ghost on 6F can't be caught. Rescue Mr. Fuji at the top.
route-12: Snorlax blocks the route. Wake it with the Poké Flute, and save first: it's your only chance to catch it. The Fishing Guru's brother gives you the Super Rod, and the girl upstairs in the gate gives TM27 Return.
route-13: Maze of fences. Hidden items around the trainer grid.
route-15: Oak's aide in the west gate gives the Exp. Share once you've caught 50 Pokémon.
route-16: Cycling Road starts here. A second Snorlax sleeps by the gate (save first). The woman in the house behind a Cut tree gives you HM02 Fly. Oak's aide in the north gate gives the Amulet Coin once you've caught 40 Pokémon.
route-17: Cycling Road, all downhill. You need the Bicycle.
route-18: Trade for Lickitung in the east gate: Golduck in FireRed, Slowbro in LeafGreen.
fuchsia-city: Gym 5, Koga (Poison): Psychic or Ground. Invisible walls inside. Reward: Soul Badge and TM06 Toxic.
The Fishing Guru gives you the Good Rod. Return the Gold Teeth from the Safari Zone to the Warden for HM04 Strength.
safari-zone: Catch Chansey, Kangaskhan, Tauros, Scyther or Pinsir, and Dratini by fishing. Find the Secret House for HM03 Surf, and grab the Gold Teeth on the way.
saffron-city: Give the guard some Tea to get in. Clear Silph Co. first: the Gym and the Dojo are blocked until then.
Beat the Karate Master in the Dojo and choose Hitmonlee or Hitmonchan.
Gym 6, Sabrina (Psychic): Bug or Ghost moves, or hit hard physically with Dark-type moves. It has a teleport-pad maze. Reward: Marsh Badge and TM04 Calm Mind.
Mr. Psychic gives you TM29 Psychic.
silph-co: Find the Card Key on 5F. The Silph employee on 7F gives you Lapras. Beat your rival on 7F and Giovanni on 11F; the president then gives you the Master Ball.
route-19: Surf south from Fuchsia toward the Seafoam Islands.
route-20: Surf west. Seafoam Islands sit in the middle of the route.
seafoam-islands: Push boulders with Strength to slow the current, then reach Articuno on B4F (Lv 50, save first).
cinnabar-island: Get the Secret Key from Pokémon Mansion to open the Gym.
Revive fossils at the Pokémon Lab. Trades in the lab: Ponyta for Seel, Raichu for Electrode, Venonat for Tangela.
Gym 7, Blaine (Fire): Water, Ground or Rock. Reward: Volcano Badge and TM38 Fire Blast.
Bill takes you to One Island after you beat Blaine.
pokemon-mansion: Statue switches open and close doors. The Secret Key is on B1F.
one-island: Meet Celio. He gives you the Tri-Pass. Later, bring him the Ruby and Sapphire for the Rainbow Pass.
kindle-road: Long route to Mt. Ember. Rock Smash rocks and fishing spots.
ember-spa: The man in the spa gives you HM06 Rock Smash.
treasure-beach: Hidden items all along the sand.
mt-ember: Beat the two Rocket grunts at the entrance. Moltres is at the summit (Lv 50, needs Strength and Rock Smash). The Ruby is at the bottom of Ruby Path (post-game).
two-island: After you rescue Lostelle, the Game Corner owner gives you a Moon Stone. Move tutors appear here later.
three-island: Clear the bikers from town. Lostelle is lost in Berry Forest.
bond-bridge: Bridge route between Three Island and Berry Forest.
berry-forest: Find Lostelle (and a Hypno, Lv 30, save first). Then return to One Island and head back to Kanto for the last badge.
route-21: Surf between Pallet Town and Cinnabar. Tangela lives here.
route-23: Badge-check gates on the way to Victory Road.
victory-road: Strength boulder puzzles. Watch out for strong Machoke and Onix.
indigo-plateau: Last Pokémon Center and Mart before the Elite Four. Stock up on Full Restores and Revives.
pokemon-league: Lorelei (Ice/Water), Bruno (Fighting/Rock), Agatha (Ghost/Poison), Lance (Dragon/Flying), then your rival for the title.
After the credits, Professor Oak upgrades you to the National Pokédex once you've seen 60 Pokémon. That opens the rest of the Sevii Islands.
cerulean-cave: Post-game. Mewtwo waits at the bottom (Lv 70). Bring your best Poké Balls, or the Master Ball.
four-island: Lorelei's hometown. The Day Care here can breed. Icefall Cave is to the north.
icefall-cave: Ice-floor puzzles. Beat the Rockets who are taking Lapras. Lorelei helps you out.
five-island: Gateway to the Rocket Warehouse and the Lost Cave.
five-isle-meadow: The Rocket Warehouse is hidden here. You find its password during the Dotted Hole story.
memorial-pillar: Bring Lemonade to the man at the pillar for TM42 Facade.
water-labyrinth: The old man gives you a Togepi Egg if you have a Pokémon with high friendship and an empty slot.
resort-gorgeous: Selphy wants to see specific Pokémon (repeatable).
rocket-warehouse: Beat the Rocket admins. Gideon hands over the Sapphire.
lost-cave: Fog maze. Find the lost girl Selphy deep inside.
six-island: Gateway to Water Path and Ruin Valley.
water-path: Show the boy a Heracross for a Nest Ball.
ruin-valley: Use Cut and Strength to open Dotted Hole (Braille puzzle).
dotted-hole: The Sapphire is at the bottom, but Gideon steals it. Chase him to the Rocket Warehouse.
green-path: Quiet route to Pattern Bush and Outcast Island.
seven-island: Trainer Tower is to the north. Sevault Canyon to the south.
sevault-canyon: Tough trainers. Phanpy, Skarmory, Larvitar and more.
tanoby-key: Strength puzzle that unlocks the Tanoby Chambers (needs the National Dex and Rainbow Pass story finished).
tanoby-ruins: Unown forms are spread across the seven chambers.
navel-rock: Event only: needs the Mystic Ticket. Lugia and Ho-Oh (Lv 70).
birth-island: Event only: needs the Aurora Ticket. Deoxys (Lv 30) after the triangle puzzle.
power-plant: Surf down the river from Route 10. Zapdos is at the back (Lv 50, save first). Some of the item balls are really Voltorb or Electrode.
three-isle-port: Small harbor area south of Three Island.
three-isle-path: Tunnel with a Dunsparce colony. Talk to the prospector after he strikes gold for a Nugget.
